browser_live_check.access: Anonymous, fresh Playwright context with isolated temp profile and Chromium under /tmp; no sign-in. Page loaded HTTP 200. Only public chart JSON and public JS asset bodies were retained; no cookies, auth headers, tokens, or account endpoints were recorded.

resolved_display_semantics.forecast_is_separate_overlay: Yes. Public chart JS computes a forecast field for the last data point only when its x date equals the current UTC rollup week. It copies original point ys and adds forecast as a separate series. The renderer uses a `forecast-bar` with `url(#forecastStripes)`, which is the hatched overlay visible at the current right edge; the raw series remain separately represented.
resolved_display_semantics.oneweek_forecast_formula: For weekly chart, UTC weekday weights are [0.1431,0.1483,0.1525,0.1515,0.1484,0.1257,0.1305] (Mon..Sun). Elapsed fraction = sum of weights for complete prior UTC days + current-day weight * (getUTCHours()/24); minutes/seconds are ignored. Factor i=1/max(0.01,elapsed fraction). Current raw total s=sum(point ys); d=s*(i-1) is additional projected use. Prior point total u is the preceding week; if s>u>0 use d uncapped; otherwise cap additional forecast at min(d,1.1*u). This makes the displayed pace a UI projection, not actual use or a frozen rule settlement input by itself.
resolved_display_semantics.observed_arithmetic_at_cachedAt: For the Oct12 current point at cachedAt Sun Oct18 10:34:06Z: prior six day weights sum 0.8695; Sunday fraction uses hour 10 only, giving elapsed fraction 0.923875; d=12.55064685175T; projected total=164.868924160918T. The live tooltip shows +12.6T and 165T respectively. Prior-week cap is 1.1*171.842501724714=189.026751897185T, so it does not bind in this displayed example.
resolved_display_semantics.total_vs_rounded_series: Tooltip total is computed from full raw series totals and then formatted separately: Oct12 raw sum 152.318T displays Total 152T, while individually displayed compact-rounded lines sum 152.46T. Oct5 raw sum 171.843T displays Total 172T while individually rounded lines sum 171.91T. Therefore do not sum already rounded model-line labels to reproduce Total.
resolved_display_semantics.formatting_observation: Series labels visibly use compact chart formatting (typically about three significant digits; e.g. 61.1T, 9.32T, 7.1T); total and weekly pace display in whole T for these values. The renderer passes series through the `compact-chart-thousands` formatter; the separate display total is corroborated by live DOM and arithmetic.
resolved_display_semantics.date_and_cutoff: Hovered tooltip headings are full UTC-week start dates “October 5, 2026” and “October 12, 2026”; x-axis ticks are sparse monthly dates. No data-through/cutoff label appears. `cachedAt` is 32 minutes earlier than the 11:06 browser response and drives only the forecast time reference in the caller; actual raw-observation cutoff remains undisclosed. The frozen Oct12–18 week was still calendar-open at capture.
resolved_display_semantics.first_display_history: Browser shows current UI values for Oct5 and Oct12. It does not provide what the chart showed when a later week first appeared; historical revisions/first-display snapshots remain unavailable.
